title: Dividend Calendar
intro: Every real dividend payment your open positions have received so far, across all portfolios — from Yahoo Finance's own dividend history, newest first. Since there's no reliable data source for future payments, this is a list of payments that already happened, not a forecast calendar.
fxUnavailable: {{count}} payment(s) couldn't be included in the TRY total since a current exchange rate wasn't available.
empty: No dividend payments recorded yet — either your positions are in assets that don't pay dividends, or you haven't added a position yet from the <link>Portfolio Analysis</link> page.
